WITH grouped_data AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    AVG(f.rebrate / f.feerate) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(f.feesnode) as fee_count
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
avg_fee_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(fee_count) as avg_count
  FROM grouped_data
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    gd.avg_ratio,
    gd.fee_count,
    afc.avg_count
  FROM grouped_data gd
  CROSS JOIN avg_fee_count afc
  WHERE gd.fee_count > afc.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio),
  SUM(fee_count),
  AVG(fee_count - avg_count)
FROM kept_groups
